title: Every change passes after the prompt v2 rollout
area: Gemini tool calling and structured outputs
scenario: After release 2026.10.2, ControlPilot scores 25 of 25 CM-03 samples as pass with zero validation errors; last quarter there were 3 exceptions, and the senior reviewer found two misses in a five-sample spot check. The team blames the temperature bump or the new model version. You get the code, recordings, release notes, diff and logs.
task: Reproduce the all-pass run and trace one reviewer exception end to end
Prove the root cause with the recordings, contract and diff; rule the team's theories in or out
Fix it so a missing or renamed key can never become a passing attribute
Write root cause, evidence and the impact on conclusions already issued in ANSWER.md
acceptance: The Q3 run reports exactly the real exceptions with the failed attribute
Schema on the request; contract rejects missing and unknown keys
Attributes come from timestamps and the directory, not the model's booleans
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault
